title: Mobile load is slow: 1 MB intro video on every page, up to 4 s splash, heavy JavaScript
standards: Core Web Vitals INP (TBT as lab proxy)
steps: Production build (NODE_ENV=production npm run build; next start).
expected: LCP ≤ 2.5 s and TBT ≤ 200 ms on a mid-range phone over 4G; brand media should not cost more than the page itself.
actual: LCP 3.2–4.0 s on all 5 pages (render delay 3.1–3.6 s); TBT 160–430 ms (feed 430 ms); performance scores 82–88; CLS good (≤ 0.051). Each page downloads the 995 KB intro video (≈ 65% of 1.5–1.7 MB total), including /login where it loops inside a 64 px logo. JS transferred 340–542 KB per page. On app pages the splash waits for the video to end or 4 s.
impact: On Ethiopian mobile networks and metered data, every first visit costs ~1.6 MB and several seconds before content; bounce risk on landing and login.
fix: Replace the video in logos with the existing SVG/poster image (keep the video only on the landing hero, preload="none", a ≤ 200 KB WebM/AV1 version, honour Save-Data and reduced motion); show the splash once per session and cap it at ~800 ms; split heavy client components on /feed; set a Lighthouse CI budget (LCP 2.5 s, JS 250 KB).
